metadata.projectName: Warehouse WMS - Moving Jobs Approval Workflow
metadata.sessionType: Multi-phase implementation: email parity + moving jobs fraud-control approval system

objectives: Sync local and VPS environments 100% identical (email settings, DB credentials, accounts)
When creating a moving job: send detailed email to internal recipients
When job is completed: send full materials (issued/returned/damaged) report with approval link
Approval link must prevent fraud; show 'approved by XYZ' in WMS after approval
If approval not granted: send reminder after N days with approval link (requires login)
Emails are internal-only (admins/specific users), NOT customer-facing

stack.backend: Node.js + Express + Prisma ORM + nodemailer + node-cron
stack.email: nodemailer with SMTP from email_settings table

architecturalDecisions.approvalModel: Use MaterialApproval table with approvalType='JOB_COMPLETION_REPORT' as fraud-control gate
architecturalDecisions.stockRestock: Defer physical restock from returns until approval is granted; apply restock auto-on-approve
architecturalDecisions.emailRecipients: Use notification_settings + notification_recipients for internal-only distribution; optional override for manual lists
architecturalDecisions.reminders: Scheduled daily cron job (11:30 AM) for pending approvals older than N days

prisma/schema.prisma.change: MaterialApproval model extended with reminder tracking
fields: notifyEmails String? @db.Text (stores JSON array of internal recipients)

prisma/migrations/20251212100000_add_mat.change: DB migration to add reminder columns + index to material_approvals table

changes: Added templates: jobCompletionApprovalRequest (with approvalUrl + materials table), jobCompletionApprovalReminder
Enhanced movingJobCreated template to support optional detail fields (phone, email, driver/vehicle, notes)
Enhanced movingJobCompleted to include approval metadata + full materials report table

src/routes/email.ts.change: Exposed JOB_COMPLETION_APPROVAL_REQUEST and JOB_COMPLETION_APPROVAL_REMINDER in notification settings so admins can configure internal recipients

changes: On job CREATE: sends MOVING_JOB_CREATED with richer fields; optional direct-send if notifyEmails override provided

On status change to COMPLETED: builds materials summary from MaterialIssue + MaterialReturn; creates/reuses MaterialApproval; sends JOB_COMPLETION_APPROVAL_REQUEST with approval link; optional direct-send override

newHelpers: applyDeferredReturnRestock(companyId, jobId) - restocks all un-restocked returns for job
src/routes/materials.ts.returns: If job-completion approval pending, returns recorded but restock deferred (flag: restockDeferred)
approvals: GET /api/materials/approvals/:approvalId - returns approval + materials summary (if JOB_COMPLETION_REPORT)
PATCH /api/materials/approvals/:approvalId - on APPROVED: applies deferred restock, sends MOVING_JOB_COMPLETED email with 'approved by' + materials report

src/cron/notificationJobs.ts.behavior: Finds pending JOB_COMPLETION_REPORT approvals older than N days (configurable); sends reminder email/notification; updates reminderCount + lastReminderAt
envVars: APP_PUBLIC_URL (required for approval link in emails; used by reminder cron)
src/cron/notificationJobs.ts.wiredInto: startAllNotificationJobs() so it runs at backend startup

src/routes/shipments.ts.change: Fixed build error by removing non-existent rack?.name reference; now uses only rack?.code

changes: Deep-link support: reads ?approvalId query param on mount; fetches approval detail from GET /api/materials/approvals/:approvalId
Displays materials summary table if approval type is JOB_COMPLETION_REPORT
Fixed approve/reject payload: sends {status: 'APPROVED'|'REJECTED', notes} instead of {decision: ...}
Maps UI fields to backend schema: requestedBy, decisionBy, job.jobCode, etc.
After approve/reject: clears query param and navigates back to /approvals

step1.action: Send MOVING_JOB_CREATED email to internal recipients with job details (phone, email, driver, vehicle, notes)

step2.action: Build materials summary; create MaterialApproval (approvalType=JOB_COMPLETION_REPORT); send approval-request email
details: Email includes full materials table (issued, returned, damaged, totals)
Stock restock from returns is DEFERRED (not applied yet)

step3.action: Apply deferred restock; send MOVING_JOB_COMPLETED email with full report + 'approved by' metadata
details: Stock is now physically returned to inventory

step4.trigger: Approval pending for > N days AND not reminded recently
step4.action: Cron job sends reminder email with approval link

issue1.problem: DB migration failed: authentication error for wms_user
issue1.rootCause: backend/.env DATABASE_URL used wmspassword, but docker MySQL was created with wmspassword123
issue1.solution: Updated DATABASE_URL password to wmspassword123 (matching workspace root .env)

issue2.problem: Approval link in reminder cron had broken fallback logic
issue2.rootCause: Used `|| fallbackUrl` which doesn't work as expected for URL construction
issue2.solution: Simplified to use APP_PUBLIC_URL or FRONTEND_URL upfront; skip job if neither set

issue3.problem: Backend build error due to non-existent rack?.name reference
issue3.solution: Removed rack?.name; uses only rack?.code for rackLocation

smoke_test: Create a Moving Job → confirm MOVING_JOB_CREATED email sent to internal recipients
View email → verify job details are correct (phone, email, driver, vehicle, notes)
Mark job COMPLETED → confirm JOB_COMPLETION_APPROVAL_REQUEST email sent
View approval email → verify approval link is clickable and includes approvalId
Click approval link → navigate to /approvals?approvalId=... and login
View approval page → confirm materials summary table is displayed
Approve → confirm status changes to APPROVED, restock is applied, completion email is sent
View completion email → confirm 'approved by [name]' and full materials report
reminder_test: Wait/manually trigger daily cron (11:30 AM) or set approval createdAt to > 2 days ago
Confirm reminder email is sent with approval link

preSteps: Ensure VPS .env has identical DB credentials (or update backend/.env to match VPS DB)
Set APP_PUBLIC_URL=https://your-domain in backend .env on VPS
deploySteps: Pull latest code (includes schema changes, migrations, new cron job, new routes, UI fixes)
Run 'npx prisma migrate deploy' on VPS backend container
Restart backend container so it loads APP_PUBLIC_URL and new code
Verify cron job shows '🛡️ Job completion approval reminder cron scheduled' in backend logs

local: Restart backend container to pick up APP_PUBLIC_URL from updated .env
Run smoke tests to verify end-to-end workflow (job create → approval → restock → completion email)
vps: Ensure APP_PUBLIC_URL is set to production domain
Run prisma migrate deploy on VPS
Test end-to-end with real VPS domain

APP_PUBLIC_URL.purpose: Base URL for approval deep-links in emails and reminder cron

JOB_COMPLETION_APPROVAL_REMINDER_DAYS.purpose: Days to wait before sending first reminder

JOB_COMPLETION_APPROVAL_MAX_REMINDERS.purpose: Max reminders to send before stopping

DATABASE_URL.purpose: Prisma DB connection string (used by CLI and server)
DATABASE_URL.note: Keep in sync with docker-compose DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD, DB_PORT

notes: All email templates support both direct-send (override recipients in request) and notification-settings-based distribution
Materials summary includes issued, returned, and damaged counts with totals
Approval workflow is integrated with existing notification infrastructure; admins can enable/disable via notification settings
Reminder cron is timezone-aware and scheduled at 11:30 AM server time daily
Stock restock is atomic: either fully applied on approval or fully deferred until approval
